**Jack**.
Chicago, Ill., Oct. 25.
**Old Pal**: I have not only got a little time but I have got some news for you and I knowed you would want to hear all a bout it so I am writeing this letter and then I am going to catch the train. I would be saying good by to little Al instead of writeing this letter only Florrie wont let me wake him up and he is a sleep but may be by the time I get this letter wrote he will be a wake again and I can say good by to him. I am going with the White Sox and giants as far as San Francisco or may be Van Coover where they take the boat at but I am not going a round the world with them but only just out to the coast to help them out because they is a couple of men going to join them out there and untill them men join them they will be short of men and they got a hole lot of exibishun games to play before they get out there so I am going to help them out. It all come off in the club house after the game today and I will tell you how it come off but 1st I want to tell you a bout the game and honest Al them giants is the luckyest team in the world and it is not no wonder they keep wining the penant in that league because a club that has got there luck could win ball games with out sending no team on the field at all but staying down to the hotel.
They was a big crowd out to the park so Callahan says to me I did not know if I was going to pitch you or not but the crowd is out here to see you so I will have to let you work so I warmed up but I knowed the minute I throwed the 1st ball warming up that I was not right and I says to Callahan I did not feel good but he says You wont need to feel good to beat this bunch because they heard a hole lot a bout you and you would have them beat if you just throwed your glove out there in the box. So I went in and tried to pitch but my arm was so lame it pretty near killed me every ball I throwed and I bet if I was some other pitchers they would not never of tried to work with my arm so sore but I am not like some of them yellow dogs and quit because I would not dissapoint the crowd or throw Callahan down when he wanted me to pitch and was depending on me. You know me Al. So I went in there but I did not have nothing and if them giants could of hit at all in stead of like a lot of girls they would of knock down the fence because I was not my self.

===Chinese===

**杰克**。
伊利诺伊州芝加哥，10月25日。
**老伙计**：我不光有点空，还有消息给你，我知道你想听个究竟，所以写这封信，写完就去赶火车。本来这会儿我该同小艾尔道别，不该写信，只是弗洛莉不许我叫醒他，他睡着呢；也许等信写完他又醒了，我就能同他道别。我要随白袜队和巨人队走，走到旧金山，也许到他们上船的温哥华，但我不环游世界，只送他们到西海岸，帮他们一把，因为有两名队员要到那边才归队，在那之前他们人手不够，到西海岸之前还有一大堆表演赛要打，我去救急。事情是今天赛后俱乐部里定的，我讲给你听，不过先说球赛。老实说，艾尔，巨人队是天底下最走运的队，难怪他们在那个联盟年年拿锦旗——他们那运气，不下场、躺在旅馆里都能赢球。
球场到了一大帮人，卡拉汉对我说：我本来拿不准派不派你，可观众是冲你来的，只好让你上。我热身时，头一颗球一出手就知道不对，我跟卡拉汉说感觉不好，他说：对付这帮人用不着好感觉，他们早听说你的大名，你把手套扔进投球区就赢定了。于是我上场硬投，胳膊疼得每投一颗都像要了我的命。换了别的投手，胳膊疼成这样才不肯上场，可我不学那帮胆小鬼撂挑子——我不能叫观众失望，也不能在卡拉汉要我投、指望着我的时候拆他的台。你是了解我的，艾尔。我上了，可我什么球路都没有，那班巨人队要是真会打，而不是像一群娘们，早把围栏打塌了，因为我根本不是我。

===Original===

At that they should not ought to of had only the 1 run off of me if Weaver and them had not of begin kicking the ball a round like it was a foot ball or something. Well Al what with dropping fly balls and booting them a round and this in that the giants was gave 5 runs in the 1st 3 innings and they should ought to of had just the 1 run or may be not that and that ball Merkle hit in to the seats I was trying to waist it and a man that is a good hitter would not never of hit at it and if I was right this here Merkle could not foul me in 9 years. When I was comeing into the bench after the 3th inning this here smart alex Mcgraw come passed me from the 3 base coaching line and he says Are you going on the trip and I says No I am not going on no trip and he says That is to bad because if you was going we would win a hole lot of games and I give him a hot come back and he did not say nothing so I went in to the bench and Callahan says Them giants is not such rotten hitters is they and I says No they hit pretty good when a man has got a sore arm against them and he says Why did not you tell me your arm was sore and I says I did not want to dissapoint no crowd that come out here to see me and he says Well I guess you need not pitch no more because if I left you in there the crowd might begin to get tired of watching you a bout 10 oclock tonight and I says What do you mean and he did not say nothing more so I set there a while and then went to the club house. Well Al after the game Callahan come in to the club house and I was still in there yet talking to the trainer and getting my arm rubbed and Callahan says Are you getting your arm in shape for next year and I says No but it give me so much pane I could not stand it and he says I bet if you was feeling good you could make them giants look like a sucker and I says You know I could make them look like a sucker and he says Well why dont you come a long with us and you will get an other chance at them when you feel good and I says I would like to get an other crack at them but I could not go a way on no trip and leave the Mrs.

===Chinese===

其实要不是韦弗他们一开始把球当足球踢来踢去，他们从我手里连那一分都得不到。唉，艾尔，掉飞球、漏接地滚，这样那样，头三局白送了巨人5分——本该只失1分，也许1分都不该失。默克尔打上看台那颗，我本想投坏球，会打的人根本不会出手；我要是状态对，这默克尔9年也碰不着我一根毛。第三局下来往休息席走，三垒指导线那个自作聪明的麦格劳迎面过来，问：你去不去？我说不去。他说：太可惜了，你要去我们能赢老多场。我顶了他一句，他没接苵。我进了休息席，卡拉汉说：巨人队打得也不赖嘛，是不是？我说：是啊，对着一条疼胳膊，谁都会打两下。他说：胳膊疼你怎么不早说？我说：我不忍心叫专程来看我的观众失望。他说：好了，你不用再投了，再让你投下去，观众看到今晚十点钟该看腻了。我问什么意思，他不再言语。我坐了一会儿，去了俱乐部。赛后卡拉汉进俱乐部来，我还在那儿同训练师说话，让人揉胳膊。卡拉汉说：提前给明年的胳膊热身哪？我说：哪儿的话，疼得我受不住。他说：我敢说，你状态好的话，准把巨人队打得像傻瓜。我说：你知道我本来就能。他说：那跟我们走一趟怎么样？等你状态好了再赢他们一回。我说：我倒想再收拾他们一回，可我不能丢下太太

===Original===

and the baby and then he says he would not ask me to make the hole trip a round the world but he wisht I would go out to the coast with them because they was hard up for pitchers and he says Mathewson of the giants was not only going as far as the coast so if the giants had there star pitcher that far the White Sox should ought to have theren and then some of the other boys coaxed me would I go so finely I says I would think it over and I went home and seen Florrie and she says How long would it be for and I says a bout 3 or 4 weeks and she says If you dont go will we start for Bedford right a way and I says Yes and then she says All right go a head and go but if they was any thing should happen to the baby while I was gone what would they do if I was not a round to tell them what to do and I says Call a Dr. in but dont call no Dr. if you dont have to and besides you should ought to know by this time what to do for the baby when he got sick and she says Of coarse I know a little but not as much as you do because you know it all. Then I says No I dont know it all but I will tell you some things before I go and you should not ought to have no trouble so we fixed it up and her and little Al is to stay here in the hotel untill I come back which will be a bout the 20 of Nov. and then we will come down home and tell Bertha not to get to in patient and we will get there some time. It is going to cost me $6.00 a week at the hotel for a room for she and the baby besides there meals but the babys meals dont cost nothing yet and Florrie should not ought to be very hungry because we been liveing good and besides she will get all she can eat when we come to Bedford and it wont cost me nothing for meals on the trip out to the coast because Comiskey and Mcgraw pays for that.
I have not even had no time to look up where we play at but we stop off at a hole lot of places on the way and I will get a chance to make them giants look like a sucker before I get threw and Mcgraw wont be so sorry I am not going to make the hole trip.

===Chinese===

和孩子出远门。他说：他不求我环游全世界全程，只求我送到西海岸，因为他们缺投手缺得慌；他说巨人队的马修森也只到西海岸——巨人队的头牌投手送到哪儿，白袜队的主投也该送到哪儿。后来又有几个伙伴劝我，末了我答应考虑考虑。回家见了弗洛莉，她问去多久，我说三四个星期。她问：你不去的话，我们是不是马上动身去贝德福德？我说是。她说：那好，去吧；只是你不在跟前，孩子万一出了什么事，可怎么办？我说：请大夫啊——能不请就别请；再说孩子生病该怎么办，你这会儿早该会了。她说：我当然会一点，可没你多，你什么都会。我说：我并非什么都会，不过走之前我教你几样，你就不至于抓瞎。我们这样讲定了：她和小艾尔留在这家旅馆等我回来，大概11月20日，然后我们一同回老家。旅馆里她带孩子的房间一周6块，饭钱另算——孩子的饭眼下还不花钱。弗洛莉不至于太饿，我们近来吃得好，到了贝德福德她敞开吃；我去西海岸一路饭钱一个子儿不用拕，科米斯基和麦格劳全包。
我们沿途在哪儿打球我都没顾上查，一路上停好多站，不等走完我就有机会让巨人队尝尝傻瓜的滋味，到那时麦格劳就不必遗憾我不走全程了。

===Original===

You will see by the papers what I done to them before we get threw and I will write as soon as we stop some wheres long enough so as I can write and now I am going to say good by to little Al if he is a wake or not a wake and wake him up and say good by to him because even if he is not only 5 months old he is old enough to think a hole lot of me and why not. I all so got to say good by to Florrie and fix it up with the hotel clerk a bout she and the baby staying here a while and catch the train. You will hear from me soon old pal.
Your pal,

**Jack**.
St. Joe, Miss., Oct. 29.
**Friend Al**: Well Al we are on our way to the coast and they is quite a party of us though it is not no real White Sox and giants at all but some players from off of both clubs and then some others that is from other clubs a round the 2 leagues to fill up. We got Speaker from the Boston club and Crawford from the Detroit club and if we had them with us all the time Al I would not never loose a game because one or the other of them 2 is good for a couple of runs every game and that is all I need to win my games is a couple of runs or only 1 run and I would win all my games and would not never loose a game.
I did not pitch today and I guess the giants was glad of it because no matter what Mcgraw says he must of saw from watching me Sunday that I was a real pitcher though my arm was so sore I could not hardly raze it over my sholder so no wonder I did not have no stuff but at that I could of beat his gang with out no stuff if I had of had some kind of decent suport. I will pitch against them may be tomorrow or may be some day soon and my arm is all OK again now so I will show them up and make them wish Callahan had of left me to home. Some of the men has brung there wife a long and besides that there is some other men and there wife that is not no ball players but are going a long for the trip and some more will join the party out the coast before they get a bord the boat but of coarse I and Mathewson will drop out of the party then because why should I or him go a round the world and throw our arms out pitching games that dont count in no standing and that we dont get no money for pitching them out side of just our bare expences.

===Chinese===

我们走成什么样，报纸上见；一路上哪儿停得够久，我就写信。现在我要去同小艾尔道个别——他醒没醒都得叫醒，他才5个月大，可也到了懂事了、喜欢我的年纪，怎么不该喜欢。我还要同弗洛莉道别，同旅馆柜上把她娘俩多住些日子安排妥，然后赶火车。很快就给你信，老伙计。
你的老伙计，

**杰克**。
密苏里州圣约瑟夫，10月29日。
**艾尔老友**：唉，艾尔，我们在去西海岸的路上，同行的人不少，不过压根不是真正的白袜队和巨人队，是两个队各出几人，再加上两大联盟别的队凑数的。波士顿队的斯皮克来了，底特律队的克劳福德来了。艾尔，这两人要是常年跟着我，我一场也输不了，他们俩随便哪个每场稳拿两三分，而我赢球一两分就够，一分就够，那我就场场赢，一场不输。
今天我没投，我猜巨人队挺高兴，因为不管麦格劳嘴上怎么说，星期日看我投过，他准明白我是个真投手——那天我胳膊疼得抬过肩都难，没球路是自然的。就那样，只要支援像点样，我空手也能赢他那帮人。也许明天，也许哪天，我就对他们投一场，如今我胳膊全好了，我要让他们领教领教，叫他们巴不得卡拉汉当初把我留在家里。有几个人带了太太，另外还有几对不是球员的夫妇，纯为旅行同行；到了西海岸还有人加入，然后一道上船。当然，到那时我和马修森就退出了——凭什么我和他要环游世界，投那些不计成绩、除开销外一个子儿不挣的球赛？

===Original===

The people in the towns we played at so far has all wanted to shake hands with Mathewson and I so I guess they know who is the real pitchers on these here 2 clubs no matter what them reporters says and the stars is all ways the men that the people wants to shake there hands with and make friends with them but Al this here Mathewson pitched today and honest Al I dont see how he gets by and either the batters in the National league dont know nothing a bout hitting or else he is such a old man that they feel sorry for him and may be when he was a bout 10 years younger then he is may be then he had some thing and was a pretty fare pitcher but all as he does now is stick the 1st ball right over with 0 on it and pray that they dont hit it out of the park. If a pitcher like he can get by in the National league and fool them batters they is not nothing I would like better then to pitch in the National league and I bet I would not get scored on in 2 to 3 years. I heard a hole lot a bout this here fade a way that he is suposed to pitch and it is a ball that is throwed out between 2 fingers and falls in at a right hand batter and they is not no body cant hit it but if he throwed 1 of them things today he done it while I was a sleep and they was not no time when I was not wide a wake and looking right at him and after the game was over I says to him Where is that there fade a way I heard so much a bout and he says O I did not have to use none of my regular stuff against your club and I says Well you would have to use all you got if I was working against you and he says Yes if you worked like you done Sunday I would have to do some pitching or they would not never finish the game. Then I says a bout me haveing a sore arm Sunday and he says I wisht I had a sore arm like yourn and a little sence with it and was your age and I would not never loose a game so you see Al he has heard a bout me and is jellus because he has not got my stuff but they cant every body expect to have the stuff that I got or ½ as much stuff.

===Chinese===

一路打过的镇子上，人们全抢着同我和马修森握手，可见不管记者们怎么说，他们心里明白这两个队的真投手是谁——明星从来就是人人抢着握手、交朋友的人。不过艾尔，这马修森今天投了，老实说，我真不懂他怎么混的：要么国家联盟的打者根本不会打球，要么他老得叫人可怜。也许他年轻个十岁时还有点东西，算个不错的投手；如今他那一套，就是把头一颗球直直送过去，然后祈祱人家别打出场地。他这样的投手都能在国家联盟混、骗过那帮打者，那我最想干的就是去国家联盟投球，我敢说两三年里失不了几分。他那所谓的“飘球”我久闻大名，说是从两指之间掷出、落向右打者，谁也打不着。可他今天要真掷过一颗，也是趁我打盹的时候——我没有一刻不是睁大眼盯着他的。赛后我问他：你那个大名鼎鼎的飘球呢？他说：哦，对你们队用不着使看家本事。我说：换成我对你投，你就得倾家荡产把本事全使出来。他说：是啊，你要都像星期日那样投，我就得真投两下了，不然比赛没完没了。接着我提到我星期日胳膊疼，他说：真希望我也疼一条你那样的胳膊，再配上你那点脑子、你那个年纪，我就一场不输了。你瞧，艾尔，他也听说过我，嫉妒我，因为他没有我的本事。不过总不能指望人人都有我的本事，连一半也不行。

===Original===

This smart alex Mcgraw was trying to kid me today and says Why did not I make friends with Mathewson and let him learn me some thing a bout pitching and I says Mathewson could not learn me nothing and he says I guess thats right and I guess they is not nobody could learn you nothing a bout nothing and if you was to stay in the league 20 years probily you would not be no better then you are now so you see he had to add mit that I am good Al even if he has not saw me work when my arm was OK
Mcgraw says to me tonight he says I wisht you was going all the way and I says Yes you do. I says Your club would look like a sucker after I had worked against them a few times and he says May be thats right to because they would not know how to hit against a regular pitcher after that. Then he says But I dont care nothing a bout that but I wisht you was going to make the hole trip so as we could have a good time. He says We got Steve Evans and Dutch Schaefer going a long and they is both of them funny but I like to be a round with boys that is funny and dont know nothing a bout it. I says Well I would go a long only for my wife and baby and he says Yes it would be pretty tough on your wife to have you a way that long but still and all think how glad she would be to see you when you come back again and besides them dolls acrost the ocean will be pretty sore at I and Callahan if we tell them we left you to home. I says Do you supose the people over there has heard a bout me and he says Sure because they have wrote a lot of letters asking me to be sure and bring you and Mathewson a long. You know me Al.
We play in Kansas city tomorrow and may be I will work there because it is a big town and I have got to close now and write to Florrie.

===Chinese===

那个自作聪明的麦格劳今天又想拿我开心，说：你怎么不同马修森交个朋友，让他教你两手表投球？我说：马修森教不了我什么。他说：想必也是，什么都教不了你；你要在联盟待上20年，多半也进步不到哪儿去。你瞧，艾尔，他不得不承认我行，哪怕还没见过我胳膊好利索时投球。
今晚麦格劳对我说：真希望你能走全程。我说：可不，我对你那队投上几回，他们就全成傻瓜了。他说：倒也是，往后他们就不懂怎么对着正经投手打球了。然后他说：不过我不操心那个，我是想你一路同行，大家痛快。他说：我们带了史蒂夫·埃文斯和达奇·谢弗，两个活宝；我就爱同好玩却不自知的小子们混。我说：我倒愿意去，就是舍不下老婆孩子。他说：是啊，这么久不在，你太太够苦的；可再想想，你回来时她该多高兴；再说，要是告诉大洋那边的姑娘们我们把你们留在了家里，她们准同我和卡拉汉没完。我问：你当那边的人听说过我？他说：那当然，来信一大摞，叮嘱我务必把你和马修森带上。他又说：我看马修森是不去了，你要去而他不去，那就没得比了，一切随你，说不定还能娶上欧洲的女王——如果你还没结婚的话。这回他可是给我交了实底，艾尔，他说这话时一丝笑都没挂。我真想去，只是对弗洛莉不公道。可话说回来，去年冬天她不也丢下我跑到得克萨斯去了吗，我何不照此办理？只因我不是那种男人。你是了解我的，艾尔。
明天在堪萨斯城比赛，多半让我投，那是大地方。我得撂笔给弗洛莉写信了。
你的老伙计，

===Original===

**Jack**.
Abilene, Texas, Nov. 4.
**Al**: Well Al I guess you know by this time that I have worked against them 2 times since I wrote to you last time and I beat them both times and Mcgraw knows now what kind of a pitcher I am and I will tell you how I know because after the game yesterday he road down to the place we dressed at a long with me and all the way in the automobile he was after me to say I would go all the way a round the world and finely it come out that he wants I should go a long and pitch for his club and not pitch for the White Sox. He says his club is up against it for pitchers because Mathewson is not going and all they got left is a man named Hern that is a young man and not got no experiense and Wiltse that is a left hander. So he says I have talked it over with Callahan and he says if I could get you to go a long it was all OK with him and you could pitch for us only I must not work you to hard because he is depending on you to win the penant for him next year. I says Did not none of the other White Sox make no holler because may be they might have to bat against me and he says Yes Crawford and Speaker says they would not make the trip if you was a long and pitching against them but Callahan showed them where it would be good for them next year because if they hit against you all winter the pitchers they hit against next year will look easy to them. He was crazy to have me go a long on the hole trip but of coarse Al they is not no chance of me going on acct. of Florrie and little Al but you see Mcgraw has cut out his trying to kid me and is treating me now like a man should ought to be treated that has did what I done.
They was not no game here today on acct. of it raining and the people here was sore because they did not see no game but they all come a round to look at us and says they must have some speechs from the most prommerent men in the party so I and Comiskey and Mcgraw and Callahan and Mathewson and Ted Sullivan that I guess is putting up the money for the trip made speechs and they clapped there hands harder when I was makeing my speech then when any 1 of the others was makeing there speech. You did not know I was a speech maker did you Al and I did not know it neither untill today but I guess they is not nothing I can do if I make up my mind and 1 of the boys says that I done just as well as Dummy Taylor could of.

===Chinese===

**杰克**。
得克萨斯州阿比林，11月4日。
**艾尔**：唉，艾尔，这会儿你知道了，自上次给你写信，我同他们对投了两场，两场全赢，麦格劳如今知道我是什么等级的投手了。我怎么知道的？昨天赛后，他同我一道坐汽车回更衣的地方，一路上劝我环游世界走全程，末了才摊牌：他要我随行，而且替巨人队投，不替白袜队投。他说他队里投手告急，马修森不去，只剩下个叫赫恩的年轻人，没经验，还有个左撇子威尔茨。他说：我同卡拉汉商量好了，只要说动你随行，他没意见，你可以替我们投，只是我不能把你使过头，他还要靠你明年替他夺锦旗呢。我问：白袜队其他人没意见？他们兴许要同我对打呢。他说：有，克劳福德和斯皮克说了，你要同去还投他们的对头，他们就不去了；可卡拉汉点醒了他们，说这对他们明年有好处——整个冬天对着你打，明年再打谁的球都跟玩似的。他一心要我走全程，可艾尔，弗洛莉和小艾尔在，我当然去不成。不过你瞧，麦格劳不再拿我开心了，如今待我，是一个干出了我这份业绩的人应得的待遇。
今天这儿下雨没赛，本地人看不上球很恼火，全围过来看我们，说一定要请随行的大人物们讲几句。于是我、科米斯基、麦格劳、卡拉汉、马修森，还有大概出钱办这趟旅行的特德·沙利文，都讲了话。我讲的时候，他们鼓掌鼓得比谁都响。你不知道我会演讲吧，艾尔？我自己也不知道，直到今天。看来只要我下决心，就没有干不成的事。有个伙伴说，我讲得不比哑巴泰勒差。

===Original===

I have not heard nothing from Florrie but I guess may be she is to busy takeing care of little Al to write no letters and I am not worring none because she give me her word she would let me know was they some thing the matter.
Yours truly,

**Jack**.
San Dago, Cal., Nov. 9.
**Friend Al**: Al some times I wisht I was not married at all and if it was not for Florrie and little Al I would go a round the world on this here trip and I guess the boys in Bedford would not be jellus if I was to go a round the world and see every thing they is to be saw and some of the boys down home has not never been no futher a way then Terre Haute and I dont mean you Al but some of the other boys. But of coarse Al when a man has got a wife and a baby they is not no chance for him to go a way on 1 of these here trips and leave them a lone so they is not no use I should even think a bout it but I cant help thinking a bout it because the boys keeps after me all the time to go. Callahan was talking a bout it to me today and he says he knowed that if I was to pitch for the giants on the trip his club would not have no chance of wining the most of the games on the trip but still and all he wisht I would go a long because he was a scared the people over in Rome and Paris and Africa and them other countrys would be awful sore if the 2 clubs come over there with out bringing none of there star pitchers along. He says We got Speaker and Crawford and Doyle and Thorp and some of them other real stars in all the positions accept pitcher and it will make us look bad if you and Mathewson dont neither 1 of you come a long. I says What is the matter with Scott and Benz and this here left hander Wiltse and he says They is not nothing the matter with none of them accept they is not no real stars like you and Mathewson and if we cant show them forreners 1 of you 2 we will feel like as if we was cheating them. I says You would not want me to pitch my best against your club would you and he says O no I would not want you to pitch your best or get your self all wore out for next year but I would want you to let up enough so as we could make a run oncet in a while so the games would not be to 1 sided. I says Well they is not no use talking a bout it because I could not leave my wife and baby and he says Why dont you write and ask your wife and tell her how it is and can you go.

===Chinese===

弗洛莉那儿没来信，多半是照顾小艾尔忙不过来，我一点也不急，她向我保证过，有事一定告诉我。
你的老伙计，

**杰克**。
加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，11月9日。
**艾尔老友**：艾尔，有时候我恨不得没结过婚。若不是弗洛莉和小艾尔，这回我就环游世界去了。想想看，我若环游世界，见遍天下该见的东西，贝德福德的小子们准眼红——老家有的小子连特雷霍特都没去过呢。我说的不是你，艾尔，是别的小子。可当然，艾尔，一个男人有了老婆孩子，就不可能丢下他们出这种远门，想也白想；可我忍不住想，因为伙伴们成天撞掇我。今天卡拉汉又同我提起，他说他知道，我要是在旅途中替巨人队投球，他们队多半赢不了；可他还是希望我去，因为罗马、巴黎、非洲那些地方的人，要是见两大俱乐部连一个王牌投手都不带，准恼火透了。他说：斯皮克、克劳福德、多伊尔、索普，各个位置上的真明星我们都带了，就差投手；你同马修森再不去一个，我们脸上不好看。我问：斯科特、本茨、还有那个左撇子威尔茨怎么了？他说：都不差，只差一样——不是你同马修森那样的真明星。给外国人看不上一位，我们就像骗了他们。我说：你总不愿我全力对你那队投吧？他说：哦不，我不愿你全力，也不愿你为这个把明年耗尽；我只愿你稍微放点水，让我们时不时得上一分，别一边倒。我说：谈也白谈，我丢不下老婆孩子。他说：那写封信问问你太太，把情况讲明，问她准不准。

===Original===

I says No because she would make a big holler and besides of coarse I would go any way if I wanted to go with out no I yes or no from her only I am not the kind of a man that runs off and leaves his family and besides they is not nobody to leave her with because her and her sister Allens wife has had a quarrle. Then Callahan says Where is Allen at now is he still in Chi. I says I dont know where is he at and I dont care where he is at because I am threw with him. Then Callahan says I asked him would he go on the trip before the season was over but he says he could not and if I knowed where was he I would wire a telegram to him and ask him again. I says What would you want him a long for and he says Because Mcgraw is shy of pitchers and I says I would try and help him find 1. I says Well you should ought not to have no trouble finding a man like Allen to go along because his wife probily would be glad to get rid of him. Then Callahan says Well I wisht you would get a hold of where Allen is at and let me know so as I can wire him a telegram. Well Al I know where Allen is at all OK but I am not going to give his adress to Callahan because Mcgraw has treated me all OK and why should I wish a man like Allen on to him and besides I am not going to give Allen no chance to go a round the world or no wheres else after the way he acted a bout I and Florrie haveing a room in his flat and asking me to pay for it when he give me a invatation to come there and stay. Well Al it is to late now to cry in the sour milk but I wisht I had not never saw Florrie untill next year and then I and her could get married just like we done last year only I dont know would I do it again or not but I guess I would on acct. of little Al.
Your pal,

===Chinese===

我说：不，她准大吵大闹；再说，真想去的话，她准不准我都去；只是我不是丢下家跑掉的那种人，况且也没人陪她——她同她姐姐艾伦太太吵翻了。卡拉汉又问：艾伦如今在哪儿，还在芝加哥吗？我说：不知道，也不想知道，我同他一刀两断了。卡拉汉说：赛季结束前我问过他去不去，他说不能去；我要知道他在哪儿，就拍电报再问一遍。我问：你要他干什么？他说：麦格劳缺投手。我说：那我帮他找一个。我说：找艾伦这样肯去的人还不容易，他老婆巴不得甩掉他呢。卡拉汉说：那好，你打听到艾伦在哪儿告诉我，我给他拍电报。唉，艾尔，艾伦在哪儿我一清二楚，可我不告诉卡拉汉：麦格劳待我这么好，凭什么把艾伦这样一个人塞给他？再说，凭他那样对待我和弗洛莉住他家公寓、还上门要房钱的做派——明明是他请我们去住的——我绝不给艾伦环游世界或去任何地方的机会。唉，艾尔，如今哭也白搭了，只恨我没晚一年认识弗洛莉，那样我和她还能像去年那样结婚——只是再选一回我选不选她还两说；看在小艾尔面上，多半还是选她。
你的老伙计，

===Original===

**Jack**.
San Francisco, Cal., Nov. 14.
**Old Pal**: Well old pal what do you know a bout me being back here in San Francisco where I give the fans such a treat 2 years ago and then I was not nothing but a busher and now I am with a team that is going a round the world and are crazy to have me go a long only I cant because of my wife and baby. Callahan wired a telegram to the reporters here from Los Angeles telling them I would pitch here and I guess they is going to be 20 or 25,000 out to the park and I will give them the best I got.
But what do you think Florrie has did Al. Her and the Allens has made it up there quarrle and is friends again and Marie told Florrie to write and tell me she was sorry we had that there argument and let by gones be by gones. Well Al it is all OK with me because I cant help not feeling sorry for Allen because I dont beleive he will be in the league next year and I feel sorry for Marie to because it must be pretty tough on her to see how well her sister done and what a misstake she made when she went and fell for a left hander that could not fool a blind man with his curve ball and if he was to hit a man in the head with his fast ball they would think there nose iched. In Florries letter she says she thinks us and the Allens could find an other flat like the 1 we had last winter and all live in it to gether in stead of going to Bedford but I have wrote to her before I started writeing this letter all ready and told her that her and I is going to Bedford and the Allens can go where they feel like and they can go and stay on a boat on Michigan lake all winter if they want to but I and Florrie is comeing to Bedford. Down to the bottom of her letter she says Allen wants to know if Callahan or Mcgraw is shy of pitchers and may be he would change his mind and go a long on the trip. Well Al I did not ask either Callahan nor Mcgraw nothing a bout it because I knowed they was looking for a star and not for no left hander that could not brake a pane of glass with his fast 1 so I wrote and told Florrie to tell Allen they was all filled up and would not have no room for no more men.
It is pretty near time to go out to the ball park and I wisht you could be here Al and hear them San Francisco fans go crazy when they hear my name anounced to pitch. I bet they wish they had of had me here this last year.
Yours truly,

===Chinese===

**杰克**。
加利福尼亚州旧金山，11月14日。
**老伙计**：老伙计，我又回到了旧金山——两年前我在这儿叫球迷大饱眼福的地方，你作何感想？那时我还只是个土包子，如今我随的是一支要环游世界的队，人家求我去，只是因为老婆孩子我去不成。卡拉汉从洛杉矶给本地记者拍了电报，说我要在这儿投球，到场的大概有两万到两万五千人，我把全副本事拿出来给他们。
可你猜弗洛莉干了什么，艾尔。她同艾伦两口子和好了，玛丽叫弗洛莉写信告诉我，说很抱歉吵了那一架，过去的事一笔勾销。唉，艾尔，我无所谓，只是忍不住替艾伦难受——我看他明年进不了联盟了；也替玛丽难受：眼看妹妹过得那样好，而自己当初迷上个左撇子，曲线球连瞎子都骗不过，快球砸上人家脑袋，人家只当鼻子痒——她心里准不好受。弗洛莉信里说，她想让我们两家再找一套去年冬天那样的公寓合住，别去贝德福德了。可我动笔写这封信之前已经给她回了信：她跟我回贝德福德，艾伦家爱去哪儿去哪儿，愿意整个冬天泡在密歇根湖的船上随他们，反正我和弗洛莉回贝德福德。她信末尾说，艾伦想知道卡拉汉或麦格劳是不是缺投手，兴许他会改主意随队走。唉，艾尔，卡拉汉、麦格劳我一个都没问，我知道人家找的是明星，不是快球连玻璃都砸不碎的左撇子。我写信叫弗洛莉告诉艾伦：人满为患，一个位置都没有了。
该去球场了。真希望你在场，艾尔，听听旧金山球迷听到我名字时报出的那阵疯。他们准后悔去年没把我弄来。
你的老伙计，

===Original===

**Jack**.
Medford, Organ, Nov. 16.
**Friend Al**: Well Al you know by this time that I did not pitch the hole game in San Francisco but I was not tooken out because they was hitting me Al but because my arm went back on me all of a sudden and it was the change in the clime it that done it to me and they could not hire me to try and pitch another game in San Francisco. They was the biggest crowd there that I ever seen in San Francisco and I guess they must of been 40,000 people there and I wisht you could of heard them yell when my name was anounced to pitch. But Al I would not never of went in there but for the crowd. My arm felt like a wet rag or some thing and I knowed I would not have nothing and besides the people was packed in a round the field and they had to have ground rules so when a man hit a pop fly it went in to the crowd some wheres and was a 2 bagger and all them giants could do against me was pop my fast ball up in the air and then the wind took a hold of it and dropped it in to the crowd the lucky stiffs. Doyle hit 3 of them pop ups in to the crowd so when you see them 3 2 base hits oposit his name in the score you will know they was not no real 2 base hits and the infielders would of catched them had it not of been for the wind. This here Doyle takes a awful wallop at a ball but if I was right and he swang at a ball the way he done in San Francisco the catcher would all ready be throwing me back the ball a bout the time this here Doyle was swinging at it. I can make him look like a sucker and I done it both in Kansas city and Bonham and if he will get up there and bat against me when I feel good and when they is not no wind blowing I will bet him a $25.00 suit of cloths that he cant foul 1 off of me. Well when Callahan seen how bad my arm was he says I guess I should ought to take you out and not run no chance of you getting killed in there and so I quit and Faber went in to finnish it up because it dont make no diffrence if he hurts his arm or dont. But I guess Mcgraw knowed my arm was sore to because he did not try and kid me like he done that day in Chi because he has saw enough of me since then to know I can make his club look rotten when I am OK and my arm is good.

===Chinese===

**杰克**。
俄勒冈州梅德福德，11月16日。
**艾尔老友**：唉，艾尔，这会儿你知道了，旧金山那场我没投满全场——撤我下来不是因为他们打我，艾尔，是我的胳膊突然不争气，全是气候突变闹的。他们出多大价钱也别想让我在旧金山再投一场。那是我在旧金山见过的最大满场，少说4万人，真希望你听听报我名字投球时那一片喊声。可艾尔，要不是为着观众，我才不上场。胳膊软得像块湿抹布，我知道自己没货；再说人挤满全场四周，只好立场地临时规则，腾空球一飞进人堆就是二垒打。那班巨人队对我全无办法，只能把我的快球挑上天，风一裹，球就落进人堆里——一帮走运鬼。多伊尔一个人往人堆里挑了三颗，你看到成绩单上他名下三支二垒打，就知道没有一支是真的，没那阵风，内场手全接杀了。这多伊尔抡棒抡得凶；可我要是状态对，他照旧金山那样抡，球早回到捕手手里了，他棒还没抡到。我能把他治成傻瓜，堪萨斯城和博纳姆我都治过；他要是肯趁我状态好、又没风的日子站进来对打，我敢同他赌一套25块的衣裳，他连一杆界外都打不出来。卡拉汉见我胳膊糟成那样，说：我看还是把你撤下来，别冒被打死的险。我就下来了，法伯上去收的尾——他的胳膊伤了不伤的，无所谓。不过麦格劳多半也看出我胳膊疼了，因为他没像芝加哥那天似的拿我开心——自那以后他见得多了，知道我状态好、胳膊好时，能把他那队治得稀烂。

===Original===

On the train that night he come up and says to me Well Jack we catched you off your strid today or you would of gave us a beating and then he says What your arm needs is more work and you should ought to make the hole trip with us and then you would be in fine shape for next year but I says You cant get me to make no trip so you might is well not do no more talking a bout it and then he says Well I am sorry and the girls over to Paris will be sorry to but I guess he was just jokeing a bout the last part of it.
Well Al we go to 1 more town in Organ and then to Washington but of coarse it is not the same Washington we play at in the summer but this is the state Washington and have not got no big league club and the boys gets there boat in 4 more days and I will quit them and then I will come strate back to Chi and from there to Bedford.
Your pal,

===Chinese===

当晚在火车上他走过来说：杰克，今天算我们撞上你没进状态，不然准捱你一顿揍。然后他说：你这胳膊缺的是多投，真该跟我们走全程，明年状态就齐了。我说：别想劝动我，省省口舌吧。他说：可惜，巴黎的姑娘们也可惜。后半句我看是玩笑。
唉，艾尔，我们在俄勒冈还有一站，然后去华盛顿——当然不是夏天打球的那个华盛顿，是华盛顿州，没有大联盟球队。伙伴们4天后上船，我就同他们分手，直回芝加哥，再回贝德福德。
你的老伙计，

===Original===

**Jack**.
Portland, Organ, Nov. 17.
**Friend Al**: I have just wrote a long letter to Florrie but I feel like as if I should ought to write to you because I wont have no more chance for a long while that is I wont have no more chance to male a letter because I will be on the pacific Ocean and un less we should run passed a boat that was comeing the other way they would not be no chance of getting no letter maled. Old pal I am going to make the hole trip clear a round the world and back and so I wont see you this winter after all but when I do see you Al I will have a lot to tell you a bout my trip and besides I will write you a letter a bout it from every place we head in at.
I guess you will be surprised a bout me changeing my mind and makeing the hole trip but they was not no way for me to get out of it and I will tell you how it all come off. While we was still in that there Medford yesterday Mcgraw and Callahan come up to me and says was they not no chance of me changeing my mind a bout makeing the hole trip. I says No they was not. Then Callahan says Well I dont know what we are going to do then and I says Why and he says Comiskey just got a letter from president Wilson the President of the united states and in the letter president Wilson says he had got an other letter from the king of Japan who says that they would not stand for the White Sox and giants comeing to Japan un less they brought all there stars a long and president Wilson says they would have to take there stars a long because he was a scared if they did not take there stars a long Japan would get mad at the united states and start a war and then where would we be at. So Comiskey wired a telegram to president Wilson and says Mathewson could not make the trip because he was so old but would everything be all OK if I was to go a long and president Wilson wired a telegram back and says Yes he had been talking to the priest from Japan and he says Yes it would be all OK I asked them would they show me the letter from president Wilson because I thought may be they might be kiding me and they says they could not show me no letter because when Comiskey got the letter he got so mad that he tore it up.

===Chinese===

**杰克**。
俄勒冈州波特兰，11月17日。
**艾尔老友**：我刚给弗洛莉写了封长信，可觉得也该给你写，因为往后好一阵子没机会了——没机会寄信，因为我要上太平洋了，除非迎面撞上一条回程的船，否则信没法寄。老伙计，我要环游世界走全程了，所以这个冬天到底还是见不着你；可见面时，艾尔，我一路的事够讲给你听的；而且每到一地靠岸，我都给你写一封。
我改主意走全程，你准吃惊，可我实在推不掉，经过讲给你听。昨天我们还在梅德福德，麦格劳和卡拉汉过来问我，走全程的事还有没有商量。我说没有。卡拉汉说：那我们可不知怎么办了。我问怎么。他说：科米斯基刚收到美利坚合众国威尔逊总统的来信，信里说，日本国王也给他来了一封，说白袜队和巨人队要是不带齐全部明星来日本，日本决不答应。威尔逊总统说，明星必须带到，否则日本一恼火，对美国开战，到那时候我们怎么办？于是科米斯基回电威尔逊总统，说马修森年纪太大不能成行，但若我随行，是否一切照旧？威尔逊总统回电说：可以——他同日本来的神父谈过了，神父说没问题。我请他们把威尔逊总统的信拿给我看，怕他们证我，他们说信拿不出来——科米斯基收到信时火气太大，撕了。

===Original===

Well Al I finely says I did not want to brake up there trip but I knowed Florrie would not stand for letting me go so Callahan says All right I will wire a telegram to a friend of mine in Chi and have him get a hold of Allen and send him out here and we will take him a long and I says It is to late for Allen to get here in time and Mcgraw says No they was a train that only took 2 days from Chi to where ever it was the boat is going to sale from because the train come a round threw canada and it was down hill all the way. Then I says Well if you will wire a telegram to my wife and fix things up with her I will go a long with you but if she is going to make a holler it is all off. So we all 3 went to the telegram office to gether and we wired Florrie a telegram that must of cost $2.00 but Callahan and Mcgraw payed for it out of there own pocket and then we waited a round a long time and the anser come back and the anser was longer than the telegram we wired and it says it would not make no diffrence to her but she did not know if the baby would make a holler but he was hollering most of the time any way so that would not make no diffrence but if she let me go it was on condishon that her and the Allens could get a flat to gether and stay in Chi all winter and not go to no Bedford and hire a nurse to take care of the baby and if I would send her a check for the money I had in the bank so as she could put it in her name and draw it out when she need it. Well I says at 1st I would not stand for nothing like that but Callahan and Mcgraw showed me where I was makeing a mistake not going when I could see all them diffrent countrys and tell Florrie all a bout the trip when I come back and then in a year or 2 when the baby was a little older I could make an other trip and take little Al and Florrie a long so I finely says OK I would go and we wires still an other telegram to Florrie and told her OK and then I set down and wrote her a check for ½ the money I got in the bank and I got $500.00 all together there so I wrote the check for ½ of that or $250.00 and maled it to her and if she cant get a long on that she would be a awfull spendrift because I am not only going to be a way untill March.

===Chinese===

唉，艾尔，末了我说：我不想搜散他们的行程，可我知道弗洛莉不会答应放我走。卡拉汉说：好办，我拍电报给芝加哥一位朋友，叫他找到艾伦，把艾伦送来，我们带他走。我说：艾伦来不及赶到了。麦格劳说：来得及，芝加哥到上船的地方有一班两天就到的车——那车绕加拿大走，一路全是下坡。我说：那好，只要你们拍电报同我太太讲妥，我就随行；她要是吵闹，一切作罢。于是我们仨一同去电报局，给弗洛莉拍了一封准花了2块的电报，钱是卡拉汉和麦格劳自己掣的腰包。我们等了好半天，回电来了，比我们发的还长。回电说：她无所谓；孩子会不会吵闹她不知道，反正他一天到晚大半在吵闹，吵不吵无所谓；但她放我走有条件——她同艾伦家合租一套公寓，整个冬天住芝加哥，不去贝德福德；雇个保姆带孩子；我把银行里的存款开张支票寄她，转到她名下，要用就取。起初我说这样的条件我一概不答应，可卡拉汉和麦格劳点醒我：不去是我的损失——能看遍那些个国家，回来讲给弗洛莉听；过一两年孩子大点，还能再走一趟，带上小艾尔和弗洛莉。末了我答应了。我们又给弗洛莉拍了一封电报说定了，然后我坐下给她开了张支票，我存款的一半。我一共存着500块，支票开的250块，寄了出去。这钱她要还不够花，那她可真是败家娘们了，因为我顶多待到3月。

===Original===

You should ought to of heard the boys cheer when Callahan tells them I am going to make the hole trip but when he tells them I am going to pitch for the giants and not for the White Sox I bet Crawford and Speaker and them wisht I was going to stay to home but it is just like Callahan says if they bat against me all winter the pitchers they bat against next season will look easy to them and you wont be supprised Al if Crawford and Speaker hits a bout 500 next year and if they hit good you will know why it is. Steve Evans asked me was I all fixed up with cloths and I says No but I was going out and buy some cloths includeing a full dress suit of evening cloths and he says You dont need no full dress suit of evening cloths because you look funny enough with out them. This Evans is a great kidder Al and no body never gets sore at the stuff he pulls some thing like Kid Gleason. I wisht Kid Gleason was going on the trip Al but I will tell him all a bout it when I come back.
Well Al old pal I wisht you was going a long to and I bet we could have the time of our life but I will write to you right a long Al and I will send Bertha some post cards from the diffrent places we head in at. I will try and write you a letter on the boat and male it as soon as we get to the 1st station which is either Japan or Yokohama I forgot which. Good by Al and say good by to Bertha for me and tell her how sorry I and Florrie is that we cant come to Bedford this winter but we will spend all the rest of the winters there and her and Florrie will have a plenty of time to get acquainted. Good by old pal.
Your pal,

===Chinese===

卡拉汉向大伙宣布我走全程时，那阵欢呼你真该听听；可他宣布我替巨人队投、不替白袜队投时，克劳福德、斯皮克那帮人准巴不得我留在家里。不过正像卡拉汉说的，整个冬天对着投我，明年打谁的球都跟玩似的；艾尔，明年克劳福德和斯皮克要是打出五成上下的打击率，你可别奇怪——真打好了，你就知道是为什么。史蒂夫·埃文斯问我行头齐不齐，我说不齐，正要去置办，连晚礼服一套算上。他说：你用不着晚礼服，不穿已经够滑稽了。这埃文斯真能耍活宝，艾尔，而且耍得没人恼，同基德·格利森一路。真希望格利森也随队，艾尔，回来我讲给他听。
唉，艾尔老伙计，真愿你也同行，咱们准能痛痛快快玩一趟。我会一路不断给你写信，每到一地给贝莎寄明信片。船上我也试着给你写，到第一个靠岸的邮局寄出——第一站不是日本就是横滨，我忘了哪个。再见了艾尔，替我同贝莎道别，告诉她我和弗洛莉多遗憾这个冬天去不了贝德福德——往后的冬天全在贝德福德过，她们俩有的是工夫亲近。再见了，老伙计。
你的老伙计，

===Original===

**Jack**.
Seattle, Wash., Nov. 18.
**Al**: Well Al it is all off and I am not going on no trip a round the world and back and I been looking for Callahan or Mcgraw for the last ½ hour to tell them I have changed my mind and am not going to make no trip because it would not be fare to Florrie and besides that I think I should ought to stay home and take care of little Al and not leave him to be tooken care of by no train nurse because how do I know what would she do to him and I am not going to tell Florrie nothing a bout it but I am going to take the train tomorrow night right back to Chi and supprise her when I get there and I bet both her and little Al will be tickled to death to see me. I supose Mcgraw and Callahan will be sore at me for a while but when I tell them I want to do the right thing and not give my famly no raw deal I guess they will see where I am right.
We was to play 2 games here and was to play 1 of them in Tacoma and the other here but it rained and so we did not play neither 1 and the people was pretty mad a bout it because I was announced to pitch and they figured probily this would be there only chance to see me in axion and they made a awful holler but Comiskey says No they would not be no game because the field neither here or in Tacoma was in no shape for a game and he would not take no chance of me pitching and may be slipping in the mud and straneing myself and then where would the White Sox be at next season. So we been laying a round all the p.m. and I and Dutch Schaefer had a long talk to gether while some of the rest of the boys was out buying some cloths to take on the trip and Al I bought a full dress suit of evening cloths at Portland yesterday and now I owe Callahan the money for them and am not going on no trip so probily I wont never get to ware them and it is just $45.00 throwed a way but I would rather throw $45.00 a way then go on a trip a round the world and leave my famly all winter.
Well Al I and Schaefer was talking to gether and he says Well may be this is the last time we will ever see the good old U.S. and I says What do you mean and he says People that gos acrost the pacific Ocean most generally all ways has there ship recked and then they is not no more never heard from them.

===Chinese===

**杰克**。
华盛顿州西雅图，11月18日。
**艾尔**：唉，艾尔，全吹了，我不环游什么世界了。前半个钟头我一直在找卡拉汉或麦格劳，要告诉他们我改了主意，不去了：对弗洛莉不公道；再说我想我该在家照顾小艾尔，不能把他丢给什么随行保姆——她能对孩子干出什么，我怎么知道。这事我不打算告诉弗洛莉，明晚我就搭车直回芝加哥，到家给她个惊喜，我敢说她同小艾尔见了我准乐疯。麦格劳和卡拉汉准得恼我一阵，可等我说明我只想做事公道、不能亏待家里人，他们就会明白我对。
我们原定在这儿赛两场，一场在塔科马，一场在这儿，全叫雨浇了。本地人恼火得很，因为报出去由我投球，他们多半想着这是见我出手的唯一机会，闹得很凶。可科米斯基说：不赛了，这儿和塔科马的场地都没法赛，我不能冒险叫我投球，万一在泥里滑倒、把自己扭了，白袜队明年怎么办？于是我们一下午闲待着，我同达奇·谢弗长谈了一场，别的伙伴出去置办随行的衣裳。唉，艾尔，我昨天在波特兰买了一套晚礼服，欠着卡拉汉的钱，如今又不去了，多半一辈子穿不上，45块白扔。可我宁可白扔45块，也不丢下家里人一冬天去环游世界。
谈着谈着，谢弗说：兴许这是咱们最后一眼看好老美利坚了。我问什么意思。他说：横渡太平洋的人，多半船要沉，沉了就再也没有音信。

===Original===

Then he asked me was I a good swimmer and I says Yes I had swam a good deal in the river and he says Yes you have swam in the river but that is not nothing like swimming in the pacific Ocean because when you swim in the pacific Ocean you cant move your feet because if you move your feet the sharks comes up to the top of the water and bites at them and even if they did not bite your feet clean off there bite is poison and gives you the hiderofobeya and when you get that you start barking like a dog and the water runs in to your mouth and chokes you to death. Then he says Of coarse if you can swim with out useing your feet you are all OK but they is very few can do that and especially in the pacific Ocean because they got to keep useing there hands all the time to scare the sord fish a way so when you dont dare use your feet and your hands is busy you got nothing left to swim with but your stumach mussles. Then he says You should ought to get a long all OK because your stumach mussles should ought to be strong from the exercise they get so I guess they is not no danger from a man like you but men like Wiltse and Mike Donlin that is not hog fat like you has not got no chance. Then he says Of coarse they have been times when the boats got acrost all OK and only a few lives lost but it dont offten happen and the time the old Minneapolis club made the trip the boat went down and the only thing that was saved was the catchers protector that was full of air and could not do nothing else but flote. Then he says May be you would flote to if you did not say nothing for a few days.
I asked him how far would a man got to swim if some thing went wrong with the boat and he says O not far because they is a hole lot of ilands a long the way that a man could swim to but it would not do a man no good to swim to these here ilands because they dont have nothing to eat on them and a man would probily starve to death un less he happened to swim to the sandwich ilands. Then he says But by the time you been out on the pacific Ocean a few months you wont care if you get any thing to eat or not. I says Why not and he says the pacific Ocean is so ruff that not nothing can set still not even the stuff you eat. I asked him how long did it take to make the trip acrost if they was not no ship reck and he says they should ought to get acrost a long in febuery if the weather was good.

===Chinese===

他问我水性好不好，我说好，在河里游过不少。他说：河里游是河里游，跟太平洋没法比。在太平洋里游泳，脚不能动——脚一动，鲨鱼就蹿上水面咬；就算不咬断，鲨鱼一口也是毒，得狂犬病；得了狂犬病，人就像狗一样吠，水灌进嘴，呛死。他又说：当然，你要能不动脚游，就没事；可极少有人能，尤其在太平洋——两只手得不停地挥，轰走剑鱼；脚不敢动，手又腾不开，剩下的就只有肚子的肌肉了。他说：你该没事，你那肚子上的肌肉成天操练，想必结实得很，所以你这样的汉子没危险；像威尔茨、迈克·唐林那样不像你这么肥的，就没指望了。他又说：倒也有船安然渡过去的时候，只折几个人命，不多见；当年明尼阿波利斯队那趟，船就沉了，唯一漂着的是捕手护胸——里头憋着气，不漂也得漂。然后他说：兴许你也能漂，只要你几天不说话。
我问：船真出事，人得游多远？他说：哦，不远，一路岛多，游得着；只是游上去也白搭，那些岛上没吃的，人多半饿死，除非撞大运游上三明治群岛。他又说：再说，在太平洋上漂了几个月，你也就吃不吃都无所谓了。我问为什么。他说：太平洋浪大得什么都稳不住，连你吃下去的东西都稳不住。我问：不出海难的话，横渡要多久？他说：天气好，2月里该到了。

===Original===

I says Well if we dont get there until febuery we wont have no time to train for next season and he says You wont need to do no training because this trip will take all the weight off of you and every thing else you got. Then he says But you should not ought to be scared of getting sea sick because they is 1 way you can get a way from it and that is to not eat nothing at all while you are on the boat and they tell me you dont eat hardly nothing any way so you wont miss it. Then he says Of coarse if we should have good luck and not get in to no ship reck and not get shot by 1 of them war ships we will have a grate time when we get acrost because all the girls in europe and them places is nuts over ball players and especially stars. I asked what did he mean saying we might get shot by 1 of them war ships and he says we would have to pass by Swittserland and the Swittserland war ships was all the time shooting all over the ocean and of coarse they was not trying to hit no body but they was as wild as most of them left handers and how could you tell what was they going to do next.
Well Al after I got threw talking to Schaefer I run in to Jack Sheridan the umpire and I says I did not think I would go on no trip and I told him some of the things Schaefer was telling me and Sheridan says Schaefer was kidding me and they was not no danger at all and of coarse Al I did not believe ½ of what Schaefer was telling me and that has not got nothing to do with me changeing my mind but I don’t think it is not hardly fare for me to go a way on a trip like that and leave Florrie and the baby and suppose some of them things really did happen like Schaefer said though of coarse he was kidding me but if 1 of them was to happen they would not be no body left to take care of Florrie and little Al and I got a $1,000.00 insurence policy but how do I know after I am dead if the insurence co. comes acrost and gives my famly the money.
Well Al I will male this letter and then try again and find Mcgraw and Callahan and then I will look up a time table and see what train can I get to Chi. I dont know yet when I will be in Bedford and may be Florrie has hired a flat all ready but the Allens can live in it by them self and if Allen says any thing a bout I paying for ½ of the rent I will bust his jaw.
Your pal,

===Chinese===

我说：2月才到，明年春训都来不及了。他说：不用春训，这一趟把你身上的分量全颠下去，别的也全颠下去。然后他说：不过晕船你倒不用怕，有一个法子躲过去——船上干脆什么都不吃；听说你本来也几乎不吃，正好省了。又说：当然，倘若我们运气好，不遇海难，也不叫军舰打中，到了那边就痛快了，欧洲那些地方的姑娘全为球员疯，尤其是明星。我问他说军舰打中是什么意思。他说：我们得经过瑞士，瑞士的军舰成天在洋面上乱开炮；当然人家不是存心打谁，可他们同多数左撇子一样没准头，下一炮打哪儿谁说得准。
唉，艾尔，同谢弗谈完，我又撞见裁判杰克·谢里登，我说我不打算去了，把谢弗的话学了几句。谢里登说谢弗净瞎扯，一点危险没有。当然，艾尔，谢弗的话我本来一半也不信，这同我改主意也不相干；我只是想，撚下弗洛莉和孩子跑那么远，实在不公道；万一谢弗说的那些事——当然他是耍我——真有一件应验了呢？到那时谁照顾弗洛莉和小艾尔？我有1000块的保单；可我死了之后，保险公司到底赔不赔、赔不赔到家里人手上，我上哪儿知道去。
唉，艾尔，寄了这信我再去找麦格劳和卡拉汉，然后查查时刻表，看哪趟车回芝加哥。几时到贝德福德还说不准；弗洛莉兴许已经租下公寓了，艾伦家自己住去，艾伦要是敢提房租我付一半，我捶碎他的下巴。
你的老伙计，

===Original===

**Jack**.
Victoria, Can., Nov. 19.
**Dear Old Al**: Well old pal the boat gos tonight I am going a long and I would not be takeing no time to write this letter only I wrote to you yesterday and says I was not going and you probily would be expecting to see me blow in to Bedford in a few days and besides Al I got a hole lot of things to ask you to do for me if any thing happens and I want to tell you how it come a bout that I changed my mind and am going on the trip. I am glad now that I did not write Florrie no letter yesterday and tell her I was not going because now I would have to write her an other letter and tell her I was going and she would be expecting to see me the day after she got the 1st letter and in stead of seeing me she would get this 2nd letter and not me at all. I have all ready wrote her a good by letter today though and while I was writeing it Al I all most broke down and cried and espesially when I thought a bout leaveing little Al so long and may be when I see him again he wont be no baby no more or may be some thing will of happened to him or that train nurse did some thing to him or may be I wont never see him again no more because it is pretty near a cinch that some thing will either happen to I or him. I would give all most any thing I got Al to be back in Chi with little Al and Florrie and I wisht she had not of never wired that telegram telling me I could make the trip and if some thing happens to me think how she will feel when ever she thinks a bout wireing me that telegram and she will feel all most like as if she was a murder.
Well Al after I had wrote you that letter yesterday I found Callahan and Mcgraw and I tell them I have changed my mind and am not going on no trip. Callahan says Whats the matter and I says I dont think it would be fare to my wife and baby and Callahan says Your wife says it would be all OK because I seen the telegram my self. I says Yes but she dont know how dangerus the trip is and he says Whos been kiding you and I says They has not no body been kiding me. I says Dutch Schaefer told me a hole lot of stuff but I did not believe none of it and that has not got nothing to do with it. I says I am not a scared of nothing but supose some thing should happen and then where would my wife and my baby be at.

===Chinese===

**杰克**。
加拿大维多利亚，11月19日。
**亲爱的老艾尔**：老伙计，船今晚开，我同行。本不该费这工夫写信，只是昨天我才写信说我不去了，你多半正等着我这几天在贝德福德露面；再说，艾尔，万一有个三长两短，我有一大堆事托付你；我还得讲讲我怎么又改了主意。幸亏昨天没写信告诉弗洛莉我不去——不然今天就得再写一封说我去，她收到头一封的第二天正等着我人呢，等来的却是第二封信，人影都没有。今天我已经给她写好了道别的信；写的时候，艾尔，我差点哭出来，一想到要同小艾尔分别这么久——再见他时，他兴许不再是娃娃了；兴许他出了什么事，那个随行保姆对他做了什么；兴许我再也见不着他了，因为十有八九，我不出事他就出事。艾尔，只要能回芝加哥同小艾尔和弗洛莉守在一起，我什么都舍得。真愿她当初没拍那封准我随行的电报；我要是没了，她一想起那封电报就想起是她亲手放的行，心里准同杀了人一样。
唉，艾尔，昨天给你写完信，我找到了卡拉汉和麦格劳，告诉他们我改了主意，不去了。卡拉汉问：又怎么了？我说：我觉得对不住老婆孩子。他说：你太太都说好了，电报我亲眼见的。我说：可她不知道这一路多凶险。他问：谁吓唬你了？我说：没人吓唬我。达奇·谢弗讲了老多话，可我一句也没信，这同那不相干。我说我什么都不怕，只怕万一出了事，我老婆孩子怎么办。

===Original===

Then Callahan says Schaefer has been giveing you a lot of hot air and they is not no more danger on this trip then they is in bed. You been in a hole lot more danger when you was pitching some of them days when you had a sore arm and you would be takeing more chances of getting killed in Chi by 1 of them taxi cabs or the dog catcher then on the Ocean. This here boat we are going on is the *Umpires of Japan* and it has went acrost the Ocean a million times with out nothing happening and they could not nothing happen to a boat that the N.Y. giants was rideing on because they is to lucky. Then I says Well I have made up my mind to not go on no trip and he says All right then I guess we might is well call the trip off and I says Why and he says You know what president Wilson says a bout Japan and they wont stand for us comeing over there with out you a long and then Mcgraw says Yes it looks like as if the trip was off because we dont want to take no chance of starting no war between Japan and the united states. Then Callahan says You will be in fine with Comiskey if he has to call the trip off because you are a scared of getting hit by a fish. Well Al we talked and argude for a hour or a hour and ½ and some of the rest of the boys come a round and took Callahan and Mcgraw side and finely Callahan says it looked like as if they would have to posepone the trip a few days un till he could get a hold of Allen or some body and get them to take my place so finely I says I would go because I would not want to brake up no trip after they had made all there plans and some of the players wifes was all ready to go and would be dissapointed if they was not no trip. So Mcgraw and Callahan says Thats the way to talk and so I am going Al and we are leaveing tonight and may be this is the last letter you will ever get from me but if they does not nothing happen Al I will write to you a lot of letters and tell you all a bout the trip but you must not be looking for no more letters for a while untill we get to Japan where I can male a letter and may be its likely as not we wont never get to Japan.
Here is the things I want to ask you to try and do Al and I am not asking you to do nothing if we get threw the trip all right but if some thing happens and I should be drowned here is what I am asking you to do for me and that is to see that the insurence co.

===Chinese===

卡拉汉说：谢弗灌了你一肚子顺风屁，这趟路上不比躺在床上危险。你那些胳膊疼的日子上场投球，比这危险得多；在芝加哥，叫出租汽车或逮狗的撞死的可能都比在海上大。我们坐的这条船叫《日本裁判号》，横渡大洋上百万趟，一回没事没出过；纽约巨人队坐的船，想出事都出不了——他们运气太好了。我说：反正我拿定主意不去了。他说：那好，这趟就吹了吧。我问：为什么？他说：威尔逊总统说日本那头的话你是知道的，你不随行，人家不答应。麦格劳说：是啊，看来行程告吹了，我们可不敢冒那个险，闹得日本同美国开战。卡拉汉又说：科米斯基因为你怕挨鱼打搜了全程，你可有脸见他。唉，艾尔，我们争了一个钟头、一个半钟头，别的伙伴也围过来帮卡拉汉和麦格劳说话。末了卡拉汉说，看来只好把行程推迟几天，等找到艾伦或者随便谁顶我的缺。我这才答应去——人家计划全定了，几位太太又已整装待发，真吹了，多叫人失望。于是麦格劳和卡拉汉说：这才像话。所以我去了，艾尔，今晚动身。这多半是你收到的我最后一封信；可要是不出事，艾尔，我会给你写老多信，行程一一讲给你。到日本之前先别等信——到了日本才寄得出信；而且十有八九，我们到不了日本。
下面是我托付你的事，艾尔——一路平安就什么都不用你做；万一出了事、我葬身鱼腹，我求你替我做的是：盯住

===Original===

dont skin Florrie out of that $1,000.00 policy and see that she all so gets that other $250.00 out of the bank and find her some place down in Bedford to live if she is willing to live down there because she can live there a hole lot cheaper then she can live in Chi and besides I know Bertha would treat her right and help her out all she could. All so Al I want you and Bertha to help take care of little Al untill he grows up big enough to take care of him self and if he looks like as if he was going to be left handed dont let him Al but make him use his right hand for every thing. Well Al they is 1 good thing and that is if I get drowned Florrie wont have to buy no lot in no cemetary and hire no herse.
Well Al old pal you all ways been a good friend of mine and I all ways tried to be a good friend of yourn and if they was ever any thing I done to you that was not OK remember by gones is by gones. I want you to all ways think of me as your best old pal. Good by old pal.
Your old pal,

**Jack**.
P.S. Al if they should not nothing happen and if we was to get acrost the Ocean all OK I am going to ask Mcgraw to let me work the 1st game against the White Sox in Japan because I should certainly ought to be right after giveing my arm a rest and not doing nothing at all on the trip acrost and I bet if Mcgraw lets me work Crawford and Speaker will wisht the boat had of sank. You know me Al.

===Chinese===

保险公司，别叫他们赖掉弗洛莉那1000块保单；再盯住银行里那250块，也叫她拿到；在贝德福德替她找个住处，她肯住的话——那儿过日子比芝加哥便宜得多，何况我知道贝莎会善待她、尽力帮她。还有艾尔，小艾尔就托你同贝莎照应，照应到他长大能自立；他要露出左撇子的苗头，千万拦住，什么都逼他用右手。唉，艾尔，倒有一桩好处：我真淹死了，弗洛莉还省得买墓地、雇灵车了。
唉，艾尔老伙计，你一向是我的好朋友，我也一向想做你的好朋友；我若有什么对不住你的地方，过去的事一笔勾销。愿你永远当我是你最好的老伙计。再见了，老伙计。
你的老伙计，

**杰克**。
又及：艾尔，倘若没出事、安然渡了洋，我要求麦格劳让我在日本对白袜队投头一场——横渡一路歇着不动，我胳膊准是齐齐整整的；麦格劳真让我投，克劳福德和斯皮克准得后悔船没沉。你是了解我的，艾尔。
